supporting_observations.claim: At 13:45:50 UTC, WS-ARUIZ-01 initiated an HTTP connection to the proxy at 10.51.20.30:8080. Zeek recorded 51,000,536 originating bytes and 9,009 response bytes over about 24 seconds, overlapping the alerted time and indicating a large transfer from the workstation to the proxy.

The available connection record identifies the proxy as the destination, but does not identify the external destination, URL, application, or content of the transfer; the record alone therefore does not establish whether the transfer was authorized or malicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied coverage status reports a collection outage for proxy logs from 13:25 to 14:15 UTC, covering the alerted connection, so no proxy request record is available here to identify its upstream destination or request details. The connection itself is recorded in T079-00176.

The supplied coverage status reports Sysmon and Windows Security collection outages on WS-ARUIZ-01 from 13:25 to 14:15 UTC, covering the alerted connection; T079-00176 is the available network record for that transfer.
claims_not_established: The external host or service that ultimately received the data.
Which process or user initiated the transfer.
What data was transferred, whether it contained sensitive information, or whether the transfer was an upload versus another large request.
Whether the transfer was authorized or associated with an approved service such as OneDrive.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover proxy access and upstream connection logs for the connection represented by T079-00176, including destination hostname, URL or CONNECT target, method, authenticated user, and request/response byte counts.
Obtain endpoint process-to-network telemetry and relevant file or application activity on WS-ARUIZ-01 around 13:45:50–13:46:14 UTC.
Check OneDrive or other approved-service audit/sync records and relevant data-transfer records for the same time window to determine whether this transfer was expected.
unrelated_findings: Separate review may be warranted for repeated TLS connections from WS-ARUIZ-01 to WS-TWEBER-01:443; the records show connections at 13:21, 13:40, 13:57, and 13:59 UTC, but do not establish their purpose or link them to the alerted proxy transfer (T079-00017, T079-00155, T079-00156, T079-00293, T079-00294, T079-00330, T079-00331).
